update.redirectPolicy: feed redirect rejected; installer redirects restricted to the explicit GitHub host allowlist

update.failureRecovery: download can be canceled; partial files are removed; identity, size, hash, install-exit or installed-version mismatch restarts the still-installed app with --update-failed instead of reporting silent success
